title: fix(plugin-security): Everyone and Guest position descriptions read as admin copy
body:
Fixes #23919
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Setup's Positions page (`/apps/setup/metadata/position`) lists each built-in position with its `description`. The two audience anchors' descriptions carried design-record ids; they now read as plain admin copy. The docblock above `AUDIENCE_ANCHOR_METADATA` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/builtin-positions.ts`), which already cited ADR-0090 D5/D9, now ties each id to the sentence it governs. Wording only: names, labels, bindings and the boot path are unchanged.

| Position | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `everyone` | "... Permission sets bound to it are the default grants for the tenant (ADR-0090 D5). High-privilege sets cannot be bound here." | "... Permission sets bound to it are the default grants for the tenant. High-privilege sets cannot be bound here." |
| `guest` | "... Bindings face the strictest checks — named objects only, read-mostly, never a wildcard (ADR-0090 D9)." | "... Bindings face the strictest checks — named objects only, read-mostly, never a wildcard." |

## The first read: what the boot path does with a stored built-in row whose description differs

Read at `origin/main` `68ffa5dc1a`, before any edit.

1. **The boot keeps the row and writes nothing.** No boot step writes a `sys_position` row: the built-in and declared position seeders are retired (`builtin-positions.ts` module doc, lines 16-19; ADR-0131 D2, C3 stage 6a). `builtin-positions.boot.test.ts` already pins this in its three existing-database scenarios: the census equals `LEGACY_ROWS` and the write ledger is empty (the case "writes no sys_position row, and leaves an existing database's rows as they were").
2. **No census reports it as drift.** The only code that classifies these rows is the upgrade ceremony (`os migrate`). `packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts` gives `sys_position` fate 2, mirror deletion, with the `SEEDED` selector (`managed_by` in package / platform / system). Only `AUTHORED` rows are converted to definitions, so a platform-managed built-in row is deleted, and it is never converted or compared.
3. **No reader shows the stored description.** No runtime package declares the `sys_position` row object any more (C3 stage 8; header of `src/__tests__/legacy-catalog-objects.testkit.ts`). The Positions nav item is `/apps/setup/metadata/position?scope=environment` (`security-plugin.ts:1587`). That is the metadata door, and it lists the declarations. The only runtime read of a `sys_position` row, `idSpellingHints` in `position-catalog-refusal.ts`, reads only the row's `name`.

So an upgraded tenant's administrator sees the declaration's text, the same as on a fresh install. The stored text is leftover data that nothing reads, and `os migrate` deletes it. The claim's stop branch assumed that existing tenants would keep the ADR ids if the boot kept the stored text. Read 3 shows that assumption is false, so this PR changes the declaration only and leaves the boot path untouched. A boot-time refresh of these rows would add a `sys_position` write that ADR-0131 C3 stage 6a retired, and nobody would see the result. The only precedent that refreshed platform-managed rows from code, `os meta resync`, was deleted in `9e9e6f97fc`.

## Pins

- `src/objects/admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts` (from the family's precedent, PR #23917) adds `securityBuiltinPositions` to its population. The label and description of all six built-in positions are judged, and the population is pinned to include `everyone`, `guest`, `platform_admin` and `org_admin`.
- `src/builtin-positions.boot.test.ts` adds one case to each existing-database scenario (`single`, `single + organization`, `walled`). For `everyone` and `guest` it asserts three things: the stored row's text (`LEGACY_ROWS`, unchanged) differs from the declaration; the census row still holds that stored text; and the security catalog read answers the declaration's text. The `LEGACY_ROWS` docblock now says that the anchors' stored text is older than their declarations.

## Verification

The implementation commit is `bebfe4cf6a`. The final head `d3a4d92391` merges `origin/main` `2054a0888c` into it. None of the four incoming commits touches plugin-security, its dependencies, or `packages/spec` source.

- Build first: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-security^...' build` (the upstream dependency closure) — exit 0. After the merge, `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs` — 75/75 tasks, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/objects/admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts src/builtin-positions.boot.test.ts`: 2 files, 63 passed. That is 55 boot cases (12 scenarios, 3 of them new existing-database cases) plus 8 vocabulary cases (1 new). Re-run on `d3a4d92391` together with `builtin-positions.test.ts` and `builtin-positions.declaration-phase.test.ts`: 4 files, 73 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test` (at `bebfe4cf6a`): 188 files passed; 3736 passed, 45 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, the scripts project, and `check:test-typecheck` over `tsconfig.test.json`: 0 errors).
- **Ablation (one time, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, on the committed tree):** I put `(ADR-0090 D9)` back into the `guest` declaration. Anchor `never a wildcard.',` went x1 to x0, and the blob went `9a36e5037bb6` to `1e2122e49ffb`. Result: 4 failed, 59 passed. The vocabulary case failed on `guest.description (an ADR number, a decision id)`, and all three new existing-database cases failed. Restore: blob `9a36e5037bb6` == HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the module from `src`, so no `dist/` leg was needed.
- Translation bundles: `pnpm check:i18n` exit 0. plugin-security has 7 bundles, all in sync, and nothing to regenerate: the bundles hold object copy, and position descriptions never reach them.
- Gates, on the final head `d3a4d92391`, after the build: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 65 commands for this diff, the same list as at `bebfe4cf6a`. All 65 exited 0, with each exit captured before any pipe. `--ran`: 65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. On the first run at `bebfe4cf6a`, `check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no `dist/`) until the build had run.
- Not run locally (CI's): `test:repo`, the dogfood shards, and the workspace type-check lanes.

## Acceptance notes

- What existing tenants see after the upgrade: the new text, the same as fresh installs. It is pinned by the existing-database case above. Their stored `everyone`/`guest` rows keep the older text until `os migrate` deletes them as seeded mirrors. This PR does not touch those rows.
- The four identity positions' descriptions come from `BUILTIN_IDENTITY_METADATA` in `@objectstack/spec`. They carry no design-record vocabulary today, and the new population case now guards them too.
